Couscous Microwave
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, February 11, 2010 - 8:53pm

Ingredients




1 cup Couscous
teaspoon Allspice -- optional
1 tablespoon Olive oil
cup Water
teaspoon Pepper -- freshly ground

Preparation

1 Commbine couscous and oil in 2 quart microwaveproof casserole and stir until all grains are coated well.This precents them from sticking together.Stir in pepper and allspice,if desired.Microwave,uncovered on high for i minutes.Stir well. Pour in water and stir.Microwave,uncovered,on high until water is absorbed and grains are tender,2 to 3 minutes. 2 Makes about 21/2 cups..
